landing.manifesto: Gabla brings every verified service provider, shop and driver in Uganda to one place. Pick a category, see who is near you, unlock their contact for a small fee, and book. You only pay after they approve your request.

phone.title: Find. Unlock. Book.
phone.body: From search to a confirmed booking without leaving Gabla. See verified providers, unlock a contact once on this device, and pay only after the provider approves.
phone.unlockSub: One-time fee, remembered on this device
